title: Problem 09
markdown:
### Problem
A sequence is defined recursively by $a_1 = 1, a_2 = 1/2$, and for $n \ge 1$:

$$a_{n+2} = a_n + \frac12 a_{n+1} + \frac{1}{2025}.$$

Prove that:

$$\sum_{n=1}^{2025} \frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} < 4.$$

### Solution (adapted from the official solution)
### Initial conditions

$$
a_1 = 1 > 0, \qquad a_2 = \frac{1}{2} > 0
$$

$$
\because\ a_{n+2} = a_n + \frac{1}{2} a_{n+1} + \frac{1}{2025} \Rightarrow a_n > 0 \quad (\forall n)
$$

★ **Use:** positive denominator + final boundary

### Proof

$$
\because\ \frac{1}{2025} > 0
$$

$$
a_{n+2} - a_n > \frac{1}{2} a_{n+1}
$$

$$
2(a_{n+2} - a_n) > a_{n+1}
$$

$$
\therefore\ \frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} < 2\left(\frac{1}{a_n a_{n+1}} - \frac{1}{a_{n+1} a_{n+2}}\right)
$$

$$
\therefore\ \sum_{n=1}^{2025} \frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} < 2\sum_{n=1}^{2025} \left( \frac{1}{a_n a_{n+1}} - \frac{1}{a_{n+1} a_{n+2}} \right)
$$

$$
= 2\left(\frac{1}{a_1 a_2} - \frac{1}{a_{2026} a_{2027}}\right)
$$

$$
\because\ a_{2026} a_{2027} > 0
$$

$$
\therefore\ 2\left(\frac{1}{a_1 a_2} - \frac{1}{a_{2026} a_{2027}}\right) < \frac{2}{a_1 a_2}
$$

$$
= \frac{2}{1 \cdot \frac{1}{2}} = 4
$$

$$
\therefore\ \sum_{n=1}^{2025} \frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} < 4
$$

### ★ Key

$$
a_1, a_2 > 0 \Rightarrow a_n > 0 \Rightarrow \text{safe division}
$$

$$
\frac{1}{2025} > 0 \Rightarrow \text{strict inequality}
$$

$$
\frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} \to 2\left(\frac{1}{a_n a_{n+1}} - \frac{1}{a_{n+1} a_{n+2}}\right) \to \text{telescope}
$$

### Conceptual Explanation
Bounding $a_{n+1} < 2(a_{n+2} - a_n)$ and dividing by $a_n a_{n+1} a_{n+2}$ yields $\frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} < \frac{2}{a_n a_{n+1}} - \frac{2}{a_{n+1} a_{n+2}}$. Summing telescopes to $\frac{2}{a_1 a_2} - \frac{2}{a_{2026} a_{2027}} < \frac{2}{1(1/2)} = 4$.

### Key Technique
[Telescoping decomposition](#node/node-telescoping-technique/sec-telescoping-core) $\frac{1}{a_n a_{n+2}} < \frac{2}{a_n a_{n+1}} - \frac{2}{a_{n+1} a_{n+2}}$.
